title: Room Ready
user: Hosts of family, classroom, and team party games who need every phone/controller/display on the same local session before guests are waiting.
smallest_useful_product: Local-first web host plus phone join page that runs a capability check, reports mixed-controller compatibility, supports a no-install practice screen, and creates a printable/TV join card.
success_measure: In observed groups of four to eight, 80% reach a ready state in under five minutes with no host troubleshooting after the first QR scan.
constraints: LAN discovery must have a manual code fallback
Provide accessible large-text and reduced-motion test screens
Do not claim compatibility for untested games
